jobs.p1_hook: tall vertical picture: a cosy living room. The main character lies on its back on a small plain sofa, head on a pillow, holding one phone up above its face with both front paws, eyes heavy and half closed, a sleepy guilty little smile; its tail hangs down off the sofa. On the wall above the sofa there is one plain square window with an empty blank pane and a simple frame, nothing visible through it. LAYOUT: the sofa with the cat is whole and big across the lower half; the window is in the upper middle with plenty of empty wall around it; the phone screen is blank; no letters or numbers anywhere.
jobs.p2_wake: tall vertical picture: the same cosy living room at night, lit only by one small lamp. The main character jolts upright on the sofa, wide-awake shocked eyes, fur standing up, ears up, the phone sliding off its chest, one paw on its head in panic; on the wall one plain window shows a dark night sky with one round moon and a few stars. LAYOUT: the cat big and whole on the sofa in the lower middle, the window in the upper part; the phone screen is blank; no letters or numbers anywhere.
jobs.p3_call: tall vertical picture: the main character sits on the floor facing the viewer, smiling warmly and confidently, holding one round alarm clock out toward the viewer in both front paws like an offer; its tail flame burns bright. LAYOUT: the cat big and whole in the lower middle, the alarm clock close to the viewer; plain wall; the clock face is blank; no letters or numbers anywhere.
jobs.p4_sink: tall vertical picture: a funny metaphor: the main character is sinking deep into a huge soft sofa as if into quicksand, only its head, one paw holding a phone and the tip of its tail with a tiny dim flame stick out of the soft cushions, the cushions bulge around it; a sleepy surrendered face. LAYOUT: the huge sofa fills the lower two thirds, the cat's head in the middle; no letters or numbers anywhere.
jobs.p5_sit: tall vertical picture: the main character sits upright and relaxed on a plain wooden chair with a cup of tea in its paws, resting calmly; on the far side of the picture, across the room, one round alarm clock stands alone on a small shelf. LAYOUT: the cat on the chair whole on the left half, the alarm clock small but clear on the shelf on the right, clear empty floor between them; the clock face is blank; no letters or numbers anywhere.
jobs.p6_up: tall vertical picture: the main character walks briskly and happily across the room toward the viewer holding one round alarm clock high in one paw like a trophy, a proud happy face with eyes half closed, mid-step; its tail flame burns big and golden with a few tiny sparks. LAYOUT: the cat big and whole in the middle; the clock face is blank; no letters or numbers anywhere.
